descriptionText: Detects dangerous writes to GITHUB_ENV or GITHUB_PATH environment files in workflows with dangerous triggers (pull_request_target or workflow_run). Writing user-controlled data to these files can allow attackers to inject environment variables or modify the PATH, potentially leading to code execution. This is especially dangerous in workflows triggered by pull_request_target or workflow_run as they run with elevated privileges. Note: This is a simplified regex-based implementation and may have false positives/negatives compared to full shell script parsing.
